mapper.select: SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, p.cloud_resource_id, r.resource_code FROM byai.byai_project p LEFT JOIN byai.ss_resource r ON r.resource_id=p.cloud_resource_id WHERE p.enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND (p.delete_flag IS NULL OR p.delete_flag <> '1') AND (p.project_type='hacu' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM byai.byai_session s WHERE s.project_id=p.project_id AND s.enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND s.session_type='hs_as' )) ORDER BY p.project_id

SELECT DISTINCT p.enterprise_id FROM byai.byai_project p JOIN byai.ss_resource r ON r.resource_id=p.cloud_resource_id AND r.resource_biz_type='KG_CLOUD' WHERE p.cloud_resource_id=#{resourceId} AND p.enterprise_id IS NOT NULL AND (p.delete_flag IS NULL OR p.delete_flag <> '1') AND (p.project_type='hacu' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM byai.byai_session s WHERE s.project_id=p.project_id AND s.enterprise_id=p.enterprise_id AND s.session_type='hs_as' ))
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM byai.tenant_config WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND params_code='COMMERCIAL_MANAGED' AND params_value='true')
